name: Toxic Cultivator
subtitle: this'll show those bastards at the fair!
rules: While you control an even number of characters, reduce the numeric cost of tactics you play by 1, to a minimum of 1.
flavor: People laugh at my toxic pusgourd. But did they slave for countless hours, rubbing it with fat and feeding it weasel paste?
notes: Card prints 'play' where catalog says 'deploy' (newer templating).

name: Unnatural Alteration
subtitle: nom nom nom
rules: COST – Play this only during your turn and not during a battle. Pick a character you control. -- EFFECT – Destroy the character if you can. If you do, X is its numeric cost. Search your deck for a character with numeric cost X+3 or less and reveal it. You may play it for free. If you don't, put it into your hand.
notes: Footer reads 'Limited edition artwork by Silvia Gunarso'. COST -> EXTRA COST and play -> deploy are newer templating.

name: Venomous Sacspider
subtitle: oh, here comes woogums now!
rules: If this card is destroyed by battle damage, your opponent discards their hand.
flavor: As pets they're surprisingly affectionate, but fragile. Slip-ups are always bad news; just a drop of their juice is enough to liquefy a cow.
notes: Card prints 'If ... your opponent'; catalog 'When ... an opponent' (newer templating).

name: Violating Anomaly
subtitle: i think one got into my pants
rules: When this card enters play, look at your opponent's hand and choose a card in it. Your opponent discards that card. -- If this card leaves play, you may pick a non-resource card. If you do, put it into its owner's hand. Draw a card.
flavor: "I thought I was a goner, but turns out they only wanted my tobacco."
notes: Card prints 'your opponent' / 'If this card leaves play'; catalog 'an opponent' / 'When' (newer templating).

name: Voidal Interference
subtitle: shiggity shiggity shwa
rules: COST – Play this only in response to a card being played. (Playing a resource doesn't count.) -- EFFECT – Terminate the card, but put it into its owner's hand instead of their discard pile. Its owner puts a card from their hand on the top of their deck.
flavor: I would say to them, "You want ice cream cone?"...and both of them say "Yes."
notes: COST -> EXTRA COST and play -> deploy are newer templating.

name: Voidal Nullification Chamber
subtitle: key component of ecto-distillation
rules: At the start of your turn, you may put a token on this card. -- ENERGIZE -- COST – Pay 2. -- EFFECT – Put a token on this card. -- DISSOLVE -- COST – Use this only if there are an even number of characters in play. Remove 4 tokens from this card. Pick a character. -- EFFECT – Destroy the character.

name: Voidal Observatory
subtitle: precisely detects irrelevant details
rules: At the start of your turn, you may put a token on this card. -- ENERGIZE -- COST – Pay 2. -- EFFECT – Put a token on this card. -- STUDY -- COST – Remove 3 tokens from this card. -- EFFECT – Draw a card.

name: Voidal Perversion
subtitle: keep that up and you're bound to go blind
rules: COST – Pick 2 or fewer non-resource cards. -- EFFECT – Put up to 2 tokens divided however you want on the cards. Draw a card.
notes: COST -> EXTRA COST is newer templating.

name: Voidal Poisoning
subtitle: magical hazard
rules: You may remove any number of tokens from cards you control. Use the tokens to generate the following effects any number of times: -- 1 TOKEN – Pick a character. Inflict 1 damage to it. -- 2 TOKENS – Draw a card. -- 2 TOKENS – Your opponent discards a card. -- 3 TOKENS – Search your deck for a card and put it into your hand.
notes: Card prints 'Your opponent discards'; catalog 'An opponent discards' (newer templating).

name: Voidal Replication
subtitle: corrupting magical experience
rules: Your opponent cannot respond to this card. -- COST – Play this only if a tactic has been played this turn. -- EFFECT – Duplicate the last tactic played this turn.
flavor: If you hit a copy of yourself, is it still considered assault?
notes: Card prints 'cannot respond' as its own paragraph before COST; catalog folds it into EXTRA COST and says 'opponents' / deploy (newer templating).

name: Anesthetizing Opulence
subtitle: i could get used to this
rules: COST – Pick a character. -- EFFECT – Destroy the character. Your opponent draws a card.
flavor: Wasn't I supposed to kill somebody? Ooh! Erotic cakes!
notes: COST -> EXTRA COST and 'your opponent' -> 'an opponent' are newer templating.

name: Armored Keep
subtitle: protected store of gold, jewels, and catnip
rules: UNIQUE ARMORED KEEP -- You may play this card whenever you could play a tactic. -- You do not lose the game because your faction has 0 influence.
notes: Card prints the full sentence 'You may play this card whenever you could play a tactic.'; catalog uses the TACTICAL keyword, which RULES.md defines as exactly that.

name: Beatrix Winterbottom
subtitle: aggressive and dominant closer of deals
rules: UNIQUE BEATRIX -- If you draw any number of cards, increase the amount by 1. -- While you have at least 10 cards in your hand, you cannot draw cards.
flavor: She doesn't care about you, she's just looking at your assets.
notes: Card prints 'If you draw'; catalog 'When you draw' (newer templating).

name: Brummagem Jewelry
subtitle: i pity the fool who don't like my jewelry
rules: ATTACH TO CHARACTER -- When this card enters play, deplete the attached character. -- The attached character cannot be restored by its controller's faction's RESTORE RULE.

name: Cash Out
subtitle: the best investment he ever made
rules: COST – Choose a number for X. Pay X+X. -- EFFECT – Draw X+1 cards.
flavor: In case of emergency, sell wife.
notes: COST -> EXTRA COST is newer templating.

name: Clandestine Resort
subtitle: ah...at last! more pudding!
rules: All your characters gain 1 life.
flavor: Every Mau secretly desires their own private island, where the feasts are endless and the beaches are littered with catnip.

name: Class Action Defender
subtitle: because corporate giants have rights too
rules: If any amount of damage greater than 4 is inflicted to this card, reduce it to 0. -- If you are attacked, you may pay 2. If you do, restore this card.
flavor: "Is that everyone? Okay, your refund is right down that alley..."
notes: Card prints 'If'; catalog 'When' (newer templating).

name: Concealed Goon
subtitle: he blends right in
rules: COVERT -- When this card enters play, your faction loses 5 influence.
flavor: Sure is lucky there aren't any goons around. Yep, no goons here. I mean, it would really suck if a goon turned up. That would ruin everything. But, um... yeah. No goons.

name: Dandy Day-Trader
subtitle: trafficker of metaphysical currency
flavor: Mortimer made a fortune investing in the gravity IPO. Unfortunately, he lost it all on a rainy day due to a massive overextension in the sunlight market.
notes: No rules text on card; text box holds only flavor.

name: Downsizing
subtitle: look busy or you could be next
rules: Destroy all characters. Your opponent's faction gains X influence, where X is the number of characters destroyed this way.
flavor: "The terms of our severance package ensure a high rate of employee retention."
notes: Card prints 'Your opponent's faction'; catalog 'Each opponent's faction' (newer templating).

name: Embezzling Bookkeeper
subtitle: your most profitable loss to date
rules: When this card enters play, your opponent draws a card.
flavor: I should have hired this guy sooner. I especially like his "employer bonus" program.
notes: Card prints 'your opponent'; catalog 'an opponent' (newer templating).

name: Entry-Level Employee
subtitle: now with 2% less chance of uprising!
rules: This card enters play with 2 tokens on it. -- This card loses 1 strength and 1 life for each token on it. -- INVEST -- COST – Pay 2. -- EFFECT – Remove a token from this card.
flavor: The default setting is "malinger," but you can reprogram it to "sabotage," "embezzle" or our newest feature, "hold out for more pay."

name: Erotic Assassin
subtitle: violent and voluptuous
rules: This card cannot be restored by your faction's RESTORE RULE. -- This card can attack only once each turn. -- RESTORE -- COST – Pay 2. -- EFFECT – Restore this card.
flavor: "Now there's a wave of destruction that's easy on the eyes."

name: Escrow Office
subtitle: wow, it really echoes in here
rules: DEPOSIT -- COST – Pay 1. -- EFFECT – Put a token on this card. -- WITHDRAW -- COST – Remove all tokens from this card. X is the number of tokens removed this way. -- EFFECT – Reduce the next numeric cost you pay this turn by X.
notes: Footer reads 'Limited edition artwork by Alex Ang'.

name: Executive Poaching
subtitle: get 'em? that was your plan?
rules: Destroy the character your opponent controls with the highest numeric cost. If there is a tie, you decide which character is destroyed.
flavor: "He's putting for eagle...this is for the entire tournament...Oh! He was stolen by a necromorph! That's got to be disappointing!"
notes: Card prints 'your opponent controls'; catalog 'an opponent controls' (newer templating).

name: Extortify
subtitle: also not actually a word
rules: Your faction gains 8 influence.
flavor: Involuntary donations are a well-established part of Mau social doctrine.
notes: Footer reads 'Limited edition artwork by Jack Heng'; 'Artist Series' watermark in text box.

name: First Unified Market of Abstract Secure Theoreticals
rules: UNIQUE F.U.M.A.S.T. -- Reduce the numeric cost of your faction's abilities by 1, to a minimum of 1.
flavor: A location so ginormous it took three artists to build.
artist: Alex Ang, Wang Hua, Yun Ling
notes: Name wraps to two lines; no subtitle line. Footer reads 'Limited edition artwork by Alex Ang, Wang Hua, Yun Ling'. Six threshold icons.

name: Free Trade Agreement
subtitle: favors all, and none
rules: At the start of each player's turn, that player chooses one of the following: -- OPTION 1 – That player may draw a card and their opponent may play a resource. -- OPTION 2 – That player may play a resource and their opponent may draw a card. -- OPTION 3 – Both players may draw up to 2 cards. -- OPTION 4 – Both players may play up to 2 resources.
notes: Card prints 'their opponent' / 'Both players'; catalog 'their opponents' / 'Each player' (newer templating).

name: Furtive Investor
subtitle: i never invest without an exit strategy
rules: COVERT -- This card enters play with 2 tokens on it. -- This card loses 1 strength and 1 life for each token on it. -- At the start of your turn, you may pick a non-resource card you control. If you do, remove a token from that card.

name: Ghostly Auditor
subtitle: balancing your books from beyond the grave
rules: While you control only 1 character, this card gains COVERT. -- If this card inflicts damage to a faction, draw 2 cards.
flavor: "You forgot to file form 37-Ohhhhh..."
notes: Card prints 'If'; catalog 'When' (newer templating).

name: Gold Summit
subtitle: who's your daddy?
rules: If you draw any number of cards, your faction gains X influence, where X is the number of cards drawn.
flavor: Randolph von Macavowitz Spitoon III, Ltd. always enjoys showing his money who's boss.
notes: Card prints 'If you draw'; catalog 'When you draw' (newer templating). Flavor spells the name 'Macavowitz'.

name: Hired Goons
subtitle: goons. hired goons.
rules: COVERT -- At the start of your turn, you may pay 2. If you don't, your opponent takes control of this card.
notes: Card prints 'your opponent'; catalog 'an opponent' (newer templating).

name: Irresistible Bribe
subtitle: dissecting moral code with diamond-like precision
rules: COST – Pick a character. X is its strength. -- EFFECT – Destroy the character. Your opponent's faction gains X influence.
flavor: Drugging the audience? Three month's salary. Bumping off last year's winner? A small fortune. Buying the judge? A king's ransom. The smile on my little girl's face? Priceless.
notes: Card: 'Your opponent's faction gains X influence' (always the opponent, even if the picked character is yours). Catalog: 'That character's controller's faction gains X influence', which changes who gains the influence when the picked character is your own.

name: Keen Stratagem
subtitle: if you want money, you'll have to pay for it
rules: Search your deck for a staple resource and reveal it. Put it into your hand.
flavor: "It is well that the people of the nation do not understand our banking and monetary system, for if they did, I believe there would be a revolution before tomorrow morning."

name: Key Man
subtitle: congratulations...you're our 23rd CEO!
rules: If this card leaves play, draw a card.
flavor: "Bruno here will uncork the bubbly when you reach altitude."
notes: Card prints 'If'; catalog 'When' (newer templating).

name: Limited Liability
subtitle: in the finest print money can buy
rules: This turn, cards can only be destroyed by costs, and all inflicted damage is reduced to 0.
flavor: "Alright, already. There's one for each arm, one for the head and one for the leg. But if you want a new shoehorn you'll have to buy it yourself. What do I look like? The charity department?"
notes: Card: 'cards can only be destroyed by costs'. Catalog adds a scope clause: 'cards in play and cards deployed can only be destroyed by costs'. Probably a clarification, but it restricts which cards are covered, so flagged for triage.

name: Mafia Lawyer
subtitle: you're not innocent until he says so
rules: When this card enters play, your faction loses 2 influence. -- If this card is destroyed during a battle, your faction gains X influence, where X is the total strength of the opposing party.
flavor: "You have the right to an attorney. If you cannot afford an attorney, Vinny and Brick there will break your kneecaps."
notes: Card prints 'If this card is destroyed during a battle'; catalog 'When' (newer templating).

name: Market Oracle
subtitle: signs point to "buy"
rules: INVEST -- COST – Deplete this card. Pick a non-resource card you control. -- EFFECT – Remove a token from the card.
flavor: I have a sell order on Empire Impoverishments when the pendulum swings north.

name: Mau Party
subtitle: it's not a party until somebody gets devoured
rules: COST – Play this only during your turn. -- EFFECT – Draw 5 cards. Your faction gains 2 influence.
flavor: After we run them over, we stop the car and eat them.
notes: COST -> EXTRA COST and play -> deploy are newer templating.

name: Mau Tough
subtitle: he'll bill you for the blood you got on his suit
rules: When this card enters play, your faction loses 4 influence.
flavor: "Well if you really want them dead, I suggest my platinum deal which includes a broken neck, two punctured lungs, a shattered hip, and a free disembowling all administered with the most extravagent bludgeons money can buy!"
notes: Flavor spellings 'disembowling' and 'extravagent' transcribed as printed.

name: Moneychanger
subtitle: don't forget to wipe your money
rules: This card loses 1 strength and 1 life for each token on it. -- EXCHANGE -- COST – Deplete this card. Put a token on this card. -- EFFECT – Draw a card.
notes: Footer reads 'Limited edition artwork by Patrick Meehan'; 'Artist Series' watermark in text box.

name: Mutiny Grant
subtitle: whatever you make, i'll double it
rules: COST – Pick a character your opponent controls. Your faction loses X influence, where X is the numeric cost of that character. -- EFFECT – This turn, take control of the character. Restore it.
notes: Card prints 'your opponent controls'; catalog 'an opponent controls' (newer templating); COST -> EXTRA COST.

name: Nasty Butler
subtitle: please wait in the garden, sir
rules: When this card enters play, your faction gains 4 influence.
flavor: "I'm ending this transmission." — L.G.

name: Overinsured Figurehead
subtitle: he used to be so down to earth
rules: If this card leaves play, draw 2 cards.
flavor: That new job title has really gone to his head. I don't like how he's always talking down to us these days.
notes: Card prints 'If'; catalog 'When' (newer templating).

name: Paralegal Prodigy
subtitle: almost ready for the big time
rules: All your other "lawyer" characters gain 1 strength and 1 life.
flavor: "Your Honor, I move for a full dismissal on the basis that the plaintiff is a doody head!"
notes: Card puts "lawyer" in quotes.

name: Pervasive Bodyguard
subtitle: keeping a watchful eye
rules: PROTECT -- COST – Pay 1. Pick a character in a party with this card. -- EFFECT – This turn, the character gains 1 life.
flavor: Since the Clockman Guard is infamously corrupt. Mau often feel the need to contract private security from their own kind to safeguard their personal interests.
notes: Footer reads 'Limited edition artwork by Steve Bentley'. Art is a grayscale photo.

name: Pettifogger
subtitle: "and furthermore..."
rules: If this card blocks, destroy it and all members of the attacking party.
flavor: "Extended articulation of the mandatory invocation of the relevant amendment for incessant objection of forward motion of trial proceeding ad nauseum etc. etc."
notes: Card prints 'If this card blocks'; catalog 'When' (newer templating).

name: Postmortem Debenture
subtitle: secured by corporeal collateral
rules: COST – Pick a character in your discard pile. -- EFFECT – Put the character into your hand.
flavor: It took Jesse Doverspike 10 years to save the down payment for his funeral. It may take him 100 to pay off the debt.
notes: COST -> EXTRA COST is newer templating.

name: Prudent Thug
subtitle: graduate from the hard knocks school of negotiation
rules: When this card enters play, your faction loses 3 influence. -- This card loses 1 strength and 1 life for each token on it. -- This card can attack only once each turn. -- RESTORE -- COST – Pay 1. Put a token on this card. -- EFFECT – Restore this card.
notes: Footer reads 'Limited edition artwork by Jack Heng'; 'Artist Series' watermark in text box.

name: Randolph von Macovawitz Spitoon III, Ltd.
rules: UNIQUE RANDOLPH -- When this card enters play, draw a card. -- PAYDAY LOAN -- COST – Pay 1. Discard a resource or destroy a resource you control. -- EFFECT – Draw a card.
flavor: Randolph has acquired the rarified status of "limited liability person," which means he cannot be held responsible for his actions as long as he's acting in his own best interest.
notes: Name wraps to two lines; no subtitle line. Card spells 'Macovawitz' in the name (Gold Summit flavor spells it 'Macavowitz').
